youtube_short.title: Your First Salary Follows You Forever
title_alternatives: The Salary Anchor That's Costing You $347K
Why Accepting a Low First Offer Is a 30-Year Mistake
youtube_short.description: You got your first job offer, it felt a little low, but you took it to get your foot in the door. Seemed fine at the time — but here's what nobody told you. Raises are percentage-based, so a low starting salary means every single raise is calculated off that same low number. Start just $5,000 below market at 22 and over a 30-year career, that one gap compounds into $347,000. And 72% of employers base your next offer on what you currently make, so the anchor just travels with you to every new job. The fix? Job-hoppers earn 50% more lifetime, and just negotiating once on your first offer can recover $5K to $10K on the spot. Only 37% of people even ask. #salary #personalfinance #moneytips #negotiate
